title: Select set type
warmUpInfo: Warm up sets won't be calculated as volume or as PRs.
failureInfo: Failure sets are counted as normal sets, but are marked as failures. Going to failure is a good, but not on every set.
dropInfo: Drop sets are performed at a lower weight and with or without a rest. They are great way to really push the set
myoRepsInfo: A hard first set, then short rests and smaller sets at the same weight. Myo-reps are great way to add additional volume to your workout.
